revision: 2: after the D-024 dialogue clarity pass on all nine scripts (hi and en). Revision 1 (pre-clarity) is superseded; its resolved items are listed under resolved_since_revision_1.
sources: content/series2/viewer-ledger.json (read in full: naming, glossary, code_phrases, must_know_by_end, must_not_know_yet, threads, lock_checks, judgement_calls)
content/series2/episodes/<all nine>/script.hi.json (read in full: actions, lines, writer_notes, clarity_pass)
content/series2/episodes/<all nine>/script.en.json (ids, speakers, heard_as and spoken text, by search)
content/series2/episodes/<all nine>/script.hi.prev.json (by search, for lines whose old wording later episodes leaned on)
content/series2/episodes/s2e01/shots.json, s2e02/shots.json, s2e03/shots.json (shot ids, beat ids, line_ids, framing, state, cut_on_word)
how_checked: Every current script.hi.json was read in full in story order per path (shared, then A, then B). Each script.en.json was searched for ids, speakers, heard_as and text and compared line by line by eye with its Hindi. Old wording was taken from each clarity_pass ledger (reworded, added, retired) and spot-checked in script.hi.prev.json. The three existing shots.json files were compared with the new beat actions and lines. Names, forms of address, 'Joshi', bare 'sir' and 'Aaiye' were searched with Grep. No JSON parser, diff or counter was run: this session has Read, Write, Edit and Grep only, no shell. This file was written by hand and checked by eye.
